exposure: epilepsy status (treated with ASMs, untreated epilepsy, no epilepsy)
cohort: The study included 22 pregnant women with epilepsy treated with ASMs, 10 nontreated pregnant women with epilepsy, and 19 control pregnant individuals without epilepsy, totaling 51 participants.
finding: Folate delivery to the fetus during late pregnancy is primarily explained by its concentrations in maternal circulation, and in persons with epilepsy, placental folate transfer may be saturable.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were more frequent among controls compared to women with epilepsy (p < .001).
gest_age: The study focused on late pregnancy and noted improved predictability of cord values upon exclusion of preterm births.
